title: Snake reading a book
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x="25" y="55" width="50" height="32" rx="4" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <rect x="25" y="55" width="50" height="6" rx="3" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <rect x="30" y="64" width="18" height="18" rx="2" fill="#fdf2e9"/>
  <rect x="52" y="64" width="18" height="18" rx="2" fill="#fdf2e9"/>
  <line x1="49" y1="64" x2="49" y2="82" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- little lines for text -->
  <line x1="33" y1="70" x2="45" y2="70" stroke="#aab7b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="33" y1="74" x2="43" y2="74" stroke="#aab7b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="33" y1="78" x2="45" y2="78" stroke="#aab7b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="70" x2="65" y2="70" stroke="#aab7b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="74" x2="63" y2="74" stroke="#aab7b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="78" x2="65" y2="78" stroke="#aab7b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- snake body coiled -->
  <path d="M20 85 Q15 75 22 66 Q30 56 40 58" fill="none" stroke="#2ecc71" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M20 85 Q28 92 40 90 Q54 87 60 88" fill="none" stroke="#27ae60" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- snake neck coming up behind book -->
  <path d="M38 58 Q36 45 38 38" fill="none" stroke="#2ecc71" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- snake head -->
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="30" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#2ecc71"/>
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="31" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#58d68d"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="27" r="3.5" fill="#fdf2e9"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="27" r="3.5" fill="#fdf2e9"/>
  <circle cx="34.5" cy="27.5" r="2" fill="#17202a"/>
  <circle cx="44.5" cy="27.5" r="2" fill="#17202a"/>
  <circle cx="35.2" cy="26.7" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="45.2" cy="26.7" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M35 34 Q39 37 43 34" fill="none" stroke="#1d8348" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- tongue flicking out -->
  <path d="M33 34 Q28 33 27 36" fill="none" stroke="#e74c3c" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M27 36 L25 35" fill="none" stroke="#e74c3c" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M27 36 L26 38" fill="none" stroke="#e74c3c" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- little hands on book -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="57" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#58d68d"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="57" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#58d68d"/>

  <!-- tail tip curl -->
  <path d="M60 88 Q68 88 70 82 Q72 77 68 76" fill="none" stroke="#2ecc71" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
